mapper.insert: insert ignore into bbs_point_record (user_id, action_type, biz_type, biz_id, point_change, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{actionType}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{pointChange}, #{remark}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now())
mapper.select: select record_id, user_id, action_type, biz_type, biz_id, point_change, remark, del_flag, create_time from bbs_point_record where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0' order by create_time desc, record_id desc
